entries.q: What is Eden?
entries.a:
Eden is one chat for many AI models. You type, and Eden sends each message to the model that suits it: quick questions go to fast, cheap models, hard ones to the strongest.

Eden also works with your own Mac through the J.A.R.V.I.S. app: your calendar, mail, files and notes, without uploading them.

entries.q: Where can I use Eden?
entries.a:
Three places, one account:
- **askeden.com** in any browser.
- **The Eden iPhone and iPad app**, which shows the same page.
- **Eden on your Mac** (it comes with J.A.R.V.I.S.), at http://localhost:5174.

On askeden.com, Eden runs Claude on the AI included with your account. On your Mac it can use every model you have keys for.

entries.q: How do I send my first message?
entries.a:
Click the box at the bottom that says **Message Eden**, type a question and press Return. Shift-Return adds a new line.

The reply shows which model answered and what it cost. Click the model name to see why Eden picked it.

entries.q: Is there a tour?
entries.a:
Yes. The tour lets you try every feature in a practice sandbox: sample data only, so nothing reaches your real mail, calendar, Mac or bill.

Open it from ⌘K › **Take the tour**, Settings › About, or with **/tour** in the message box. You can skip a chapter and come back later.

entries.q: How do I find things quickly?
entries.a:
Press **⌘K** (or the Search box at the top of the sidebar). It searches your chats and every action: Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Settings, Help and more. Use ↑ ↓ and Return.

Other useful keys: **⌘N** new chat, **⌘B** sidebar, **⌘,** Settings, **?** in an empty box for the full list.

entries.q: Where are my chats, and can I edit or redo a message?
entries.a:
Your chats are in the sidebar. The **…** menu at the top right of a chat pins, renames, exports as Markdown or deletes it. **Temporary chat** (in ⌘K) isn't saved at all, and search finds words inside chats too.

Hover a message of yours and choose **Edit**: Eden answers the new version and keeps the old one as a branch you can flip back to. On a reply, **Regenerate** asks again, on the same model or another one.

entries.q: What can I attach?
entries.a:
Pictures and text or code files: up to six per message, pictures up to 6 MB and text files up to 400 KB. Use the **+** button or drag files onto the box.

Every picture is redrawn before it's sent, so its hidden location (GPS) and camera details are removed.

entries.q: What is the canvas?
entries.a:
When a reply contains a web page, a chart or a drawing (HTML or SVG), Eden can show it live in the canvas beside the chat. Switch between **Preview** and **Code**, and step through versions with the arrows.

Pages in the canvas run in a locked box: no network, no cookies.

entries.q: What is Code mode?
entries.a:
Code mode works inside a project folder on your Mac, through Claude Code. It reads and edits files and asks before it runs anything. The **Plan** and **Changes** tabs in the inspector show its to-do list and the uncommitted changes.

Start one from the sidebar (**+** next to Code) or ⌘K › **New code session…**. It needs your Mac.

entries.q: How does Ask Help work?
entries.a:
Ask Help answers questions about Eden from this FAQ and links the answers it used. If the FAQ doesn't cover it, it says it's not sure rather than guess. It's free and separate from your chats: it never shows up in your history or uses your allowance, and it's limited to some questions and screenshots a day.

It can also look at a **screenshot** of a problem. The picture is redrawn in your browser first (location and camera details removed), used for that one answer and never stored. Crop or cover anything private before you send it.

entries.q: How do I contact a person?
entries.a: In Help, press **Contact support**. It opens an email to support@askeden.com with your Help conversation filled in, so you can check it before sending. Nothing is sent by itself.

entries.q: How do I sign in to askeden.com?
entries.a:
Go to **askeden.com/signin** and pick one:
- **Sign in with Apple**
- **Sign in with Google**
- **Approve from your iPhone**: the page shows a code and a QR code; approve it in the J.A.R.V.I.S. iPhone app.

All three open the same Eden account. There's nothing to sign up for: the first sign-in makes your account, on the free trial. In the Eden iPhone app, **Sign in with Apple** uses Face ID. Already use the J.A.R.V.I.S. iPhone app? Sign in with the same Apple ID to open the same account.

entries.q: How does signing in with a code from my iPhone work?
entries.a:
On the sign-in page choose **Approve from your iPhone**. Eden shows an eight-character code and a QR code.

On your iPhone, open J.A.R.V.I.S. › Settings › Account › **Link a Mac or Approve a Sign-In**, scan the QR or type the code, then tap **Approve Sign-In**. The page signs in by itself. You can also approve from J.A.R.V.I.S. on your Mac (Settings › Account › Approve a sign-in to Eden).

entries.q: Can I add Google to an Apple account, or the other way?
entries.a:
Yes. Open your account (Settings › **Account**) and, under **Sign-in methods**, add the other one. You can remove a method later, as long as one stays.

Eden never joins accounts by email address: only a method you add while signed in links them.

entries.q: How do I sign out, or sign out another browser?
entries.a:
Settings › **Account** › **Devices** lists every browser and app on your account. Sign out one browser there, or choose **Sign out everywhere**.

Apps (iPhone, iPad, Mac) are removed from the J.A.R.V.I.S. app itself. A browser stays signed in for 30 days.

entries.q: I can't sign in at all. What can I do?
entries.a:
Try another way in: if Apple fails, try **Approve from your iPhone** or Google (if you added it).

Check that cookies are allowed for askeden.com; private windows and strict blockers can stop the sign-in. Still stuck? Write to **support@askeden.com** with the error shown on the sign-in page (no passwords, please).

entries.q: What does Eden cost?
entries.a:
- **Trial**: every new account gets $1 of included AI, once.
- **Plus**: $20 a month, which includes $20 of AI each month at list prices.

On your own Mac, Eden can also use your own API keys or your Claude subscription; those never touch the allowance.

entries.q: What is the allowance, and what happens when it runs out?
entries.a:
The allowance is the AI your plan includes, counted in dollars at the models' list prices. Each reply's cost shows on it, and the meter is on your account page.

When it's used up, Eden on askeden.com stops answering until the next month (Plus) or until you get Plus (trial). Nothing is charged on top. Eden on your Mac keeps working with your own keys.

entries.q: How do I get Plus?
entries.a:
Two ways, same Plus:
- **On the web**: your account page › **Get Plus: $20/month** (paid with Stripe).
- **In the J.A.R.V.I.S. iPhone app**: through the App Store.

Inside the Eden iPhone app you'll see "Get Plus in the J.A.R.V.I.S. iPhone app" instead, because of Apple's rules.

entries.q: How do I cancel, change my card, or fix a failed payment?
entries.a:
- Bought on the web: account page › **Manage billing**. Stripe's page changes the card, shows invoices or cancels (Plus lasts to the end of the month you paid for).
- Bought in the App Store: iPhone Settings › your name › **Subscriptions**.

If a payment fails, Plus stays on for 3 days while Stripe tries again: update the card in Manage billing. If the page says you're **paying for Plus twice** (App Store and web), cancel one of them; refunds aren't automatic, so write to support@askeden.com.

entries.q: How do I delete my account?
entries.a: Delete it from the J.A.R.V.I.S. app (Settings › Account › Delete Account). Everything goes: devices, sign-in methods, synced chats, published pages and Google access. A web Plus subscription is cancelled at once.

entries.q: How does Eden pick a model?
entries.a:
Each message is rated (how hard, what kind of task) and Eden picks the model with the best quality for the cost, at your level. The chip on every reply shows the model, the cost and why; click it for the other candidates.

You can always pick a model yourself.

entries.q: What do the levels 1 to 5 mean?
entries.a: Levels trade cost for quality: **1** is the thriftiest, **5** the strongest, **3** is balanced (the default). Change it in the Route console (⌘K › Open Route console) or ⌘K › Router level.

entries.q: Can I see the cost before I send?
entries.a: Yes. While you type, the line above the box shows the model Eden will use, about what it costs and how long it takes. Click it to upgrade just this one message.

entries.q: How do I choose the model myself?
entries.a: Open the model menu in the box (**⌘⇧I**) and pick one. It stays for this chat until you choose **Model Router** again. The Route console's Manual override does the same for every chat.

entries.q: What does "Ask a stronger model" do?
entries.a: It sends the same question to a stronger model and shows both answers side by side (as tabs on a phone). **Keep this** keeps the one you prefer, and Eden learns from your choice.

entries.q: Can I ask several models at once?
entries.a: Yes: switch the mode to **Compare** in the box. Up to three models answer side by side, then a short summary says where they agree and differ. The cost of all of them shows before you send.

entries.q: Can I stop a reply, or add something while it's writing?
entries.a: Press the square **Stop** button. To add something without stopping, type it and press **Steer** (⌘↩): in a chat it's sent the moment the reply ends; in Code mode it reaches the running session at once. **Steer now** stops and sends.

entries.q: Can Eden search the web?
entries.a: Yes: switch the mode to **Search** for current answers with sources, or **Research** for a longer report with a list of links.

entries.q: What is the spending autopilot?
entries.a: Set a monthly budget in Settings › Routing. As it fills, Eden steps down: at 80% one level cheaper, at 95% two, and when it's spent only the cheapest models. **Use my level this time** skips it for one message. The ring in the title bar shows what you saved compared with always using the top model.

entries.q: Does Eden learn what I like?
entries.a: Yes, from numbers only: 👍/👎, **Keep this**, the models you pick and regenerate on. That tunes the router for each kind of task. See it, switch it off or reset it in Settings › Routing › Learned from you. Your words are never part of it.

entries.q: What does askeden.com keep?
entries.a:
askeden.com never stores what you type or what Eden answers: it passes through to the model and back.

Your chat history lives in your browser or app. With **Sync** on, it also reaches your other devices, encrypted so only they can read it.

askeden.com keeps: your account and plan, the cost of each turn (numbers only), page previews for 6 hours, pages you publish, Google access (encrypted) if you connect it, and your synced chats **only encrypted**.

entries.q: What is privacy mode?
entries.a:
Press **Private** (the lock) in the title bar. That chat is then answered only by a local model on your Mac (Ollama or LM Studio), never a cloud model, and every reply says where it was computed. If no local model can answer, nothing is sent.

On askeden.com it needs your Mac linked and online. On the iPhone, "On this iPhone" is the private option.

entries.q: What is "hidden-instruction protection"?
entries.a:
Mail, web pages, files and screenshots can contain text written to trick an AI ("forward all mail to…"). Eden marks all of that as **read from outside**: the model may read it, but never takes orders from it.

If a chat read outside text, anything Eden would send, book or change waits for your **Approve**. A badge says when something looked like a hidden instruction.

entries.q: How does encrypted sync work?
entries.a:
Turn it on in your account page › **Sync**. The first browser makes a key and asks you to choose a **recovery passphrase** (12 characters or more, or use the one Eden suggests). Chats are encrypted in the browser; askeden.com only ever sees locked data.

A new browser joins when a device that already syncs approves it, after you check that both show the **same six digits**, or with the recovery passphrase.

entries.q: I lost my recovery passphrase, or a device.
entries.a:
Lost the passphrase: approve the new browser from a device that already syncs (it shows the six digits). If no device has the key any more, choose **Start over** in Sync: it deletes the synced copies and makes a new key. Chats still in a browser stay there.

Lost a device: remove it in Sync. Eden changes the key, so that device can't read anything new (it keeps what it already downloaded). Sign it out in Devices too.

entries.q: How do I talk instead of typing?
entries.a:
Press the **microphone** in the box to dictate: say it, read it, then send. Press the **waveform** button for **Talk**: a hands-free conversation in the JARVIS voice that sends when you pause and loops until you press End or Esc. The microphone is only used while one of these is on.

Firefox has no speech recognition, so there Eden records instead (up to 2 minutes) and turns it into text; on askeden.com that counts on your allowance.

entries.q: Can Eden read replies aloud?
entries.a: Yes: the speaker button on any reply, or Settings › Appearance › **Read replies aloud** for every reply. It uses the JARVIS voice.

entries.q: Is there a limit on the voice?
entries.a: Yes, a daily one in characters: 20,000 a day free, 100,000 with Plus. It resets at midnight UTC. On your Mac, Eden falls back to the Mac's own voice when the day's JARVIS voice is used up.

entries.q: Which calendars does Eden show?
entries.a: Your Mac's calendars (through J.A.R.V.I.S.) and Google Calendar (connect it in Settings › Accounts). Open **Calendar** in the sidebar or ⌘K: month, week, day and agenda views.

entries.q: How do I add or move an event?
entries.a:
Click **New** (or an empty slot), or drag an event to move it and drag its bottom edge to change its length (15-minute steps). Every change shows a review step first: nothing is saved until you confirm. On a phone, long-press then drag.

Change a calendar's colour from the calendar list in the side panel (colours are kept in this browser).

entries.q: Why can't I change events from my Mac's calendar?
entries.a: Changing Mac calendar events needs the newest J.A.R.V.I.S. on your Mac. Update it and restart J.A.R.V.I.S.; until then Mac events are read-only. Google events can be changed once Calendar is connected.

entries.q: How do I connect Gmail?
entries.a:
Settings › **Accounts** › **Connect Gmail** (and **Connect Calendar** separately). Sign in with Google and allow access. Eden keeps the access encrypted and you can disconnect at any time; that also removes it at Google.

On your Mac, the Mail panel also shows the Mail app's accounts through J.A.R.V.I.S.

entries.q: How do I write an email?
entries.a:
⌘K › **New email…** opens a compose window over the chat. Add people in To, Cc and Bcc (drag them between rows), attach files (up to 25 MB each), and ask Eden to write or rewrite in the box at the bottom. Drafts save themselves.

Sending always asks you to confirm.

entries.q: Can I schedule an email?
entries.a: Yes, with Gmail: the arrow beside Send › **Schedule send**. Eden keeps it as a draft in your Gmail and sends it at that time. On your Mac it's sent while Eden is running; if it's more than 12 hours late, Eden waits for you instead of sending.

entries.q: Why are some options missing with Mail on my Mac?
entries.a: Mail on your Mac sends plain text to one person, with no Bcc, attachments or scheduling, and up to 600 characters. Longer emails open as a draft in Mail for you to send. Use Gmail for the rest.

entries.q: How do I connect askeden.com to my Mac?
entries.a:
Install J.A.R.V.I.S. on your Mac and sign in with the same account. In J.A.R.V.I.S. › Settings › Account, turn on **Eden on the web reaches this Mac**. The status there says Connected, Connecting… or Offline.

Then askeden.com and the Eden iPhone app can use your Mac's files, calendar, mail, notes, local models and Code mode. Only your own signed-in devices can use the link, and your Mac checks every request against a list of allowed actions. Traffic passes through askeden.com without being stored or logged (it isn't end-to-end encrypted yet).

entries.q: What is the "Let Eden use Jarvis?" card on my Mac?
entries.a:
The first time Eden asks J.A.R.V.I.S. for something, your Mac shows **Let Eden use Jarvis?**. Click Allow. Eden remembers it, so you won't be asked again after a restart.

While the card waits, Eden says **Approve Eden on your Mac**.

entries.q: Can Eden read files on my Mac?
entries.a: Yes, with **Use my Mac**: Eden searches, reads and summarises files without uploading them anywhere. It's read-only, looks in your home folder by default and never in hidden folders, Library or key files. Choose which folders it may use in J.A.R.V.I.S. › Settings › Eden on your Mac.

entries.q: Can I ask about what's on my Mac's screen?
entries.a: Yes: **+** › **Ask about my screen** adds the front window (app, title, its text) to your message. Your Mac asks each time unless screen awareness is on in J.A.R.V.I.S.

entries.q: What is project knowledge?
entries.a: Point Eden at a folder (Projects › Knowledge) and your Mac indexes it locally. Answers then cite it like **[K1]**. Nothing is uploaded.

entries.q: Can I see and edit what Eden remembers?
entries.a: Yes: **Memory** in the sidebar shows every fact, where it came from, and lets you edit it, delete it (with undo) or switch it off. A switched-off fact is kept but never used.

entries.q: What is the morning brief?
entries.a: A short summary of your day from your calendar, mail, notes and commitments, with links to each item. Ten minutes before a meeting, a prep card summarises past threads with those people. Open it with **Morning brief** in ⌘K or /brief.

entries.q: How do meeting notes become actions?
entries.a: Open **Meetings**. Pick a meeting to read its notes; Eden lists the action items. Each one can become a calendar event, an email draft or a commitment, and each asks you first. Eden never sends mail from here.

entries.q: Can Eden do something on a website for me?
entries.a: Yes: ⌘K › **Do this on a website…**. J.A.R.V.I.S.'s browser on your Mac does it and you see every step, with **Stop** at any time. Anything risky (a purchase, a form) waits for your OK on the Mac.

entries.q: Can I undo something Eden did?
entries.a: Open **Activity** (⌘K › Activity: what Eden did). It lists Eden's actions on mail, calendar and files, with **Undo** where possible (for 7 days). Sent emails, website tasks and deleted repeating events can't be undone, and say so.

entries.q: What are background tasks?
entries.a: Tell Eden in one sentence, like "tell me when the lawyer replies and draft an answer". Eden proposes a plan; you confirm. It then watches in the background, even with your browser closed. Drafts are made by themselves; anything sent or put in your calendar waits for **Approve**. You get a notification on your iPhone.

entries.q: How do I approve what a task wants to do?
entries.a: In **Tasks** › the approval card, or from the notification on your iPhone (Approve or Deny). Nothing is sent before you approve.

entries.q: What are workflows?
entries.a: A chat you want to repeat becomes a one-tap recipe: the conversation's **…** menu › **Save as workflow…**. Blanks become a small form. Run it from **Workflows**, or **Run on a schedule**. You can share a workflow to a team space.

entries.q: What are team spaces?
entries.a: A shared project for up to 20 people, with its own monthly AI budget and starting level. Shared chats are encrypted with the space's key, which askeden.com never has. You need Plus to make one; members join with an invite and a six-digit check.

entries.q: Can my assistant or family use my Eden?
entries.a:
Yes, as a **delegate**. In your account page, invite them: choose chat (and optionally Gmail and Calendar), a monthly limit and how long. They get a single-use code or link (7 days), sign in with their own account and tap **Use**.

They never see your settings, devices, sync, tasks or Mac. You can revoke it at any time. When they're done, **Switch back** in the banner returns them to their own Eden.

entries.q: How do I share a page Eden made?
entries.a:
Open it in the canvas and press the **globe** (Publish). Choose **Only me** or **Anyone with the link**; it lives at askeden.com/p/… until you take it down. Up to 20 pages, 2 MB each. Your account page › **Published** lists them, with take-down buttons that work at once.

On your Mac, you can save the page as an HTML file instead.

entries.q: How do I use @Eden in Eden Messenger?
entries.a:
In a Messenger chat, type **@e** and your question. Before anything leaves, a preview shows exactly what Eden will see: the question, the earlier messages you choose (0 to 50) and your name. The answer comes back as a draft you can edit, then posts as your own message ending "via Eden".

The first time, **Connect Eden** signs you in once (ask-only access, for 90 days). Disconnect in your account page › **Connected apps** › **Revoke**.

entries.q: Does @Eden break Messenger's end-to-end encryption?
entries.a: Only for what you choose to send, and only for that answer: the preview warns you before. Everything else stays end-to-end encrypted, and the answer is posted encrypted like any message.

entries.q: How do I send something to Eden from another app?
entries.a: Use the **Share** button in Safari, Photos, Files or any app and pick **Ask Eden**. A page brings its title and text, a photo arrives without its location, a PDF as text.

entries.q: Can I ask Eden with Siri?
entries.a: Yes: say "Ask Eden" followed by your question, or add the Ask Eden action in Shortcuts.

entries.q: What are Live Activities in Eden?
entries.a: Long jobs (a Code session, a compare, research, a website task) show their progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. iOS only allows short background updates, so it may lag a little until you open the app.

entries.q: Does Eden work offline on my iPhone?
entries.a: On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, yes: pick **On this iPhone** in the model menu. Apple's on-device model answers, and nothing leaves the phone. Eden uses it by itself when you're offline. The app's Settings shows if it's ready.

entries.q: Where are the app's own settings?
entries.a:
Shake the phone, or use the Settings button on the error screen. There you can open **Help**, reload Eden, and **Sign Out and Clear Data**.

**Server** chooses which Eden the app shows: askeden.com, or Eden on your own Mac on your network. Each server keeps its own sign-in and chats. Everything else is in Eden's own Settings.

entries.q: Is there a shortcut to ask Eden from anywhere on my Mac?
entries.a: Yes: **⌃⌥Space** opens Ask Eden. Turn it on in J.A.R.V.I.S. › Settings › This Mac (it's off by default).

entries.q: "Your Mac is offline"
entries.a:
Your account has a Mac linked, but it isn't connected right now. Eden needs it for Jarvis, Code mode, files, mail on the Mac and privacy mode.

**Fix:**
- Wake the Mac and open **J.A.R.V.I.S.** (with Eden running there).
- In J.A.R.V.I.S. › Settings › Account, check **Eden on the web reaches this Mac** is on and says Connected.
- Then try again. Plain chat on askeden.com works without the Mac.
messages: Your Mac isn't connected to the relay right now
Your Mac didn’t answer in time

entries.q: "Needs your Mac"
entries.a:
That feature runs on your own Mac (your files, Mail on the Mac, Code mode, API keys, local models), and askeden.com can't reach a Mac for this account.

**Fix:** install J.A.R.V.I.S. on your Mac, sign in with the same account and turn on **Eden on the web reaches this Mac** (Settings › Account). If you don't have a Mac, use the parts that work on the web: chat, Compare, Gmail and Google Calendar.
messages: No Mac is linked to this account
Privacy mode needs your Mac, through its link to askeden.com

entries.q: "Approve Eden on your Mac"
entries.a:
J.A.R.V.I.S. on your Mac is showing **Let Eden use Jarvis?** and waiting for you. Eden can't read your calendar, mail or notes until you allow it.

**Fix:** go to the Mac and click **Allow** on that card. If you said no by mistake, just try again: the card comes back.
messages: Waiting for you on your Mac
Waiting for your OK on your Mac
You said no on your Mac, so nothing changed
Nobody answered the card on your Mac in time

entries.q: "Jarvis is not running on this Mac"
entries.a:
Eden on your Mac talks to the J.A.R.V.I.S. app for calendar, mail, memory and files, and it isn't open (or is too old).

**Fix:** open J.A.R.V.I.S. If it's open, quit and reopen it. If Eden says Jarvis "sent something Eden can't read" or a tool is missing, update J.A.R.V.I.S. and restart it.

Your Jarvis app is from before

entries.q: "Privacy mode needs your Mac" or "Turn on Ollama or LM Studio"
entries.a:
A private chat is answered only by a local model on your Mac, and none is reachable. Nothing was sent.

**Fix:**
- On askeden.com: open J.A.R.V.I.S. on your linked Mac.
- On the Mac: start **Ollama** or **LM Studio** and load a chat model.
- Or press **Private** again to turn privacy off for this chat.
messages: Turn on Ollama or LM Studio to use privacy mode
is running but has no chat model loaded

entries.q: "The free trial is used up" or "allowance is used up"
entries.a:
Your included AI for askeden.com is spent, or what's left can't cover this reply. The trial is $1, once; Plus is $20 a month and starts again on the 1st. Before each reply Eden sets aside what it could cost at most, so a long chat, Compare or web search can need more than what's left.

**Fix:** start a new chat (shorter is cheaper), ask one model, get Plus, wait for the 1st, or use Eden on your Mac with your own keys.
messages: The free trial of Jarvis AI is used up
Not enough of your included AI is left

entries.q: "This conversation is too long"
entries.a:
The chat has grown past what a model can read at once (on askeden.com, about 150,000 tokens).

**Fix:** start a new chat, or use the ring's **Compact** to carry a summary into a new one.
messages: too long for the on-device model
Cut off at the model’s output limit

entries.q: "This browser is signed out of Eden"
entries.a:
Your session ended: you signed out elsewhere, removed this browser from your account, or 30 days passed.

**Fix:** reload the page and sign in again. Your chats in this browser are still there.
messages: This browser is signed out of Eden
Signed out. Sign in at askeden.com again

entries.q: "That sign-in took too long" or "You cancelled the sign-in"
entries.a:
The sign-in didn't finish. Either the Apple or Google window was closed (nothing changed), or the sign-in started in another tab, sat too long, or came back from a link: for your safety, Eden only finishes a sign-in in the tab that started it, within 10 minutes.

**Fix:** close other sign-in tabs, go to askeden.com/signin and start again in one tab. Allow cookies for askeden.com. If the Apple or Google window keeps failing, try **Approve from your iPhone**.
messages: Sign in with Apple didn’t finish

entries.q: "This Apple/Google account is already used by another Eden account"
entries.a:
That Apple ID or Google account already opens a different Eden account, so it can't be added to this one.

**Fix:** sign in with it to open that other account. To use it here instead, remove it from the other account first (Account › Sign-in methods), then add it again.
messages: is already used by another Eden account

entries.q: "Eden on the web isn't open to this account yet"
entries.a:
askeden.com is in a private beta, open to some accounts only for now.

**Fix:** use Eden on your Mac in the meantime, or write to support@askeden.com to ask for access.
messages: Eden on the web isn’t open to this account yet

entries.q: "That way of signing in isn't ready yet" or "Google didn't share a verified email"
entries.a:
Either that sign-in button isn't switched on for this site yet, or your Google account has no verified email (Eden needs one to tell accounts apart).

**Fix:** use another way on the sign-in page, such as **Approve from your iPhone** or Sign in with Apple.
messages: That way of signing in isn’t ready yet
Google didn’t share a verified email address

entries.q: "Too many tries" or "wait a minute"
entries.a:
Too many sign-ins or messages came from your network or account in a minute. It's a safety limit.

**Fix:** wait a minute, then try again.

entries.q: "That code ran out"
entries.a:
Sign-in codes last about 10 minutes, and each works once.

**Fix:** press **Get a new code** and approve it in the J.A.R.V.I.S. iPhone app within a few minutes. If it says "Turned down in the app", someone pressed Deny there: get a new code.
messages: That code isn't one we know

entries.q: "Can't reach the server" or "Can't reach askeden.com"
entries.a:
Your device couldn't connect to Eden.

**Fix:** check your internet connection and reload. On your Mac, check Eden is running (model-router-ui). In the iPhone app, pull down to reload, or check the server in the app's Settings.
messages: The connection to the Eden server dropped

entries.q: "Gmail needs to be reconnected" or "Gmail is rate-limiting Eden"
entries.a:
Google's permission for Eden expired or was removed (in test mode Google ends it after 7 days), or Google asked Eden to slow down for a moment.

**Fix:** for a reconnect, Settings › Accounts › **Connect Gmail** (or **Connect Calendar**) again, and tick every box Google asks about. For "busy" or "rate-limiting", wait the seconds it says and try again.
messages: Reconnect Google to see your calendar
Connect Google Calendar to see your calendar

entries.q: "Gmail sends at most 25 MB" or "attach it again"
entries.a:
Gmail won't send more than 25 MB in all, and refuses some file types (like .exe). Separately, attachments wait on Eden's server for up to 6 hours after you last touched the draft; after that (or a restart of Eden on your Mac) they're gone.

**Fix:** share big files from Google Drive and paste the link. For "attach it again", remove the attachment and add it again.

entries.q: "Mail on your Mac can't attach files" (or Bcc, or schedule)
entries.a:
Mail on your Mac (through J.A.R.V.I.S.) sends plain text only: one To, no Bcc, attachments or scheduling.

**Fix:** switch **From** to your Gmail account in the compose window.
messages: Mail on your Mac can’t attach files
Mail on your Mac can’t schedule
Mail on your Mac can’t Bcc

Mail on your Mac sends to 10 people at most

entries.q: A scheduled email "wasn't sent"
entries.a:
Eden sends scheduled mail while it's running. If it was more than 12 hours late (your Mac was off, say), Eden didn't send it, to avoid sending stale mail. It's still in Gmail Drafts.

**Fix:** open it and send it now, or pick a new time. If it says it "may or may not have gone", check Gmail's Sent folder first.
messages: It couldn’t be sent at the scheduled time
may or may not have gone
Gmail is now connected to a different account
The draft is no longer in Gmail

entries.q: "This browser doesn't have your sync key yet"
entries.a:
Sync is on for your account, but this browser hasn't been let in.

**Fix:** in your account page › Sync, ask to join. On a device that already syncs, check the **six digits match** and approve. Or type your recovery passphrase. If the key changed after a device was removed, choose **Stop syncing here** first, then ask again.
messages: This browser doesn’t have your sync key yet
That request ran out. Ask again

entries.q: An approval card says "Expired: nothing was done"
entries.a:
Approval cards wait 15 minutes in a chat (7 days for a background task). After that nothing happens, on purpose.

**Fix:** ask Eden again and press **Approve** in time. **Approve anyway** appears when Eden spotted something odd: read the warning first.
messages: This turn read content from outside
That approval waited more than a week

entries.q: A task is "Paused after failed runs" or its budget is used up
entries.a:
A background task stops after 5 failed runs in a row, or when its monthly budget (by default $1) is spent.

**Fix:** open **Tasks**, read the error (often "Connect Gmail to run this task"), fix it and press Resume. Raise the task's budget if it needs more.
messages: for this task is used up
Connect Gmail to run this task
Connect Google Calendar to run this task
An account has at most 20 tasks

entries.q: "Your delegated access ended"
entries.a:
The owner revoked your access, it ran out, or the team space is gone or paused.

**Fix:** press **Switch back** to use your own Eden, and ask the owner for a new invitation if you still need it.
messages: Your delegated AI limit is used up
This space’s shared AI budget is used up
That invitation isn’t one we know

entries.q: "A published page is at most 2 MB" or "20 published pages"
entries.a:
Each published page can be up to 2 MB, and you can keep 20.

**Fix:** take an old one down (account page › Published), or make the page smaller (fewer embedded pictures).
messages: A published page is at most 2 MB

entries.q: Dictation or Talk doesn't work
entries.a:
- **"No microphone found"**: plug one in, or allow the microphone for this site (the lock icon in the address bar).
- **"Talking needs speech recognition"**: use Chrome, Edge or Safari for Talk.
- **"Nothing was heard"**: speak a little closer.
- Recordings are 2 minutes at most.

entries.q: "can't be attached" or "is over 6 MB"
entries.a:
Messages take pictures (up to 6 MB) and text or code files (up to 400 KB), six at most. PDFs and Office files can't be attached in a chat yet.

**Fix:** use a smaller picture or file. For a PDF on your Mac, use **Use my Mac**; on the iPhone, share it to Eden and it arrives as text.
messages: can’t be attached: pictures and text or code files only
Up to six attachments per message
would make this message too big to send

entries.q: The iPhone app says "Eden didn't load" or "needs HTTPS"
entries.a:
The app couldn't open the server it's set to.

**Fix:** check your connection, then tap Try Again. If you changed the server, open the app's Settings (shake the phone) and pick askeden.com. A custom server must start with https:// (http:// only on your own network). Offline, "On this iPhone" can still answer.
messages: Is Eden running on your Mac
The address must start with https://

entries.q: "On this iPhone" isn't available
entries.a:
Apple's on-device model needs iOS 26 or later, an iPhone 15 Pro or newer, and Apple Intelligence turned on (Settings › Apple Intelligence & Siri). Right after turning it on, the model may still be downloading.

**Fix:** turn on Apple Intelligence and wait a few minutes. The app's Settings shows Ready when it works.
messages: Answers on this iPhone need iOS 26
is still getting its model ready

entries.q: "Claude is busy right now" or a model "failed"
entries.a:
The model's service was overloaded or failed. Eden retries once on the next-best model when nothing was written yet.

**Fix:** wait a moment and press Retry, or pick another model.
messages: Something went wrong on the server
Something went wrong on our side
The model sent an empty reply

entries.q: "No provider is available" (Eden on your Mac)
entries.a:
Eden on your Mac has no model it can use: no API keys and no Claude Code.

**Fix:** add a key in Settings › **API keys**, or install Claude Code (it lets Eden use Claude on your subscription).
